source='''def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    motif = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    copies = sum(value == 4 for row in grid for value in row)
    return [row * copies for row in motif]
'''
